items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Both initial and delivery-refresh pre-push trees are covered without extending scope beyond P2.39.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Missing, unmarked, and undecodable consumer scripts no-op; a marked gate failure blocks the refresh push.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: The identity marker prevents executing an unrelated common-path script under STOP semantics; no secrets or input boundary changed.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Mutation tests reject prose and fall-through handlers; runtime tests cover ordering, red paths, and no-op cases.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: The accepted one extra local gate runs only after an integration that would otherwise push a changed tree.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: The helper follows delivery-host conventions and stays below the repository file-size ratchet.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized producer/consumer format changed; the boundary is a local process invocation covered by focused integration-style tests.
